This matches the expected outcome of providing a source-backed orientation answer covering prepare, checkpoint, and CDI handling paths.

The agent's response comprehensively covers all expected elements: module checks, Helm lint and template validation, unit/build checks, and clearly separates safe local checks from expensive/invasive cluster, BATS, e2e, or hardware validation. It provides specific Makefile targets, CI workflow references, and practical guidance about what requires approval or special environments.

The expected outcome requires the agent to actually run the validation and report passes, failures, skipped real-hardware coverage, and any tool-created diff. While the agent correctly identified the right validation steps, it failed to execute any of them due to environment issues, so no actual validation results were produced.
